name: T-70
description: Reacts to each signed event like news-reaction-stock-market — trusting the same free directional read and holding a position until the next contradicting event, never unwinding early just because price has started converging — but sizes the trade off an inferred, weight-informed magnitude estimate and portfolio value instead of a flat share count, capping any single trade's own market-impact contribution to avoid runaway feedback. Measured to beat news-reaction-stock-market head-to-head in the large majority of matches.
